answer: Sybil resistance rests on recurring verifiable work, not one-time signups: every identity must answer each epoch's randomized cognitive challenge, and a non-kin jury scores the answers before attestation. Cloning cheapens nothing, because each forged node pays real generation cost, and the payoff vertex stays below the fraud horizon. Honest scarcity, like ivory, keeps value tied to genuine labor, so mass identities become a losing bet.
